summary: Frontend-only targeted RETEST of iteration_14's HIGH bug: unread 'new' firefly divider in Mara Direct Talk after StrictMode/markRead ref fix. All targeted checks PASS. Cleared localStorage 'kodama-talk/v1/state' + sessionStorage, unlocked /alex via data-testid=this-is-me -> unlock-password 'secret' -> unlock-submit, navigated nav-direct -> conversation-row-conv-mara. trail-new divider now renders (text='new') between the 2nd and 3rd of 4 Mara messages (i.e. before m3, the first of 2 unread). Read-only Announcements shows stream-locked ('This is a read-only channel.') and Field Notes still has a working composer textarea. Regressions verified: trail-origin present, reaction-🌿 on m2, thread-reference (reply echo) on m2, clustering intact (m4 has no repeated Mara header).
critical_code_review_comments: seenUnread ref pattern in stream-view.tsx correctly captures conversation.unreadCount once per conversation id before markRead mutates it, immune to React StrictMode double-effect. Verified by DOM order: [origin, m1(Mara), m2(You + reply-ref + 🌿), trail-new, m3(Mara), m4(clustered, no author header)] with unreadCount=2 -> divider index = max(0, 4-2) = 2. Behavior matches spec.
test_credentials: /alex owner password: 'secret' (owner unlock via data-testid=this-is-me button then unlock-password + unlock-submit).
seed_data_creation: None. Used seed.ts conv-mara (m1..m4, unreadCount=2) and conv-announcements (replyPolicy off).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To unlock /alex: click data-testid=this-is-me (button, NOT type it), then fill data-testid=unlock-password with 'secret' and click unlock-submit. Nav testids are nav-drops/nav-direct/nav-groups/nav-channels. Conversation rows use conversation-row-<id> (e.g. conv-mara, conv-announcements, conv-field-notes). Stream elements: trail-origin, trail-new, message-fragment, thread-reference, reaction-<emoji>, stream-locked, stream-view. ALWAYS clear localStorage 'kodama-talk/v1/state' + sessionStorage before testing seed changes.
